credits.title: Roots
credits.overview: When an ancestry test leaves Andre, a Black teenager adopted into a white family, questioning his place among those he loves most, he turns to his older brother for help. Together, they devise an unlikely plan to convince their parents that he is their biological son.

credits.title: Mr. Irrelevant
credits.overview: The last player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants, underdog John Tuggle, defies expectations on and off the field for head coach Bill Parcells, his newfound love, and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

credits.title: Baba Anka & The Devil
credits.overview: An elderly woman is approached by a salesman who attempts to manipulate her into signing a contract.

credits.title: Falling for Daisy
credits.overview: Outspoken teenager Artemisia embarks on a new romance with musician Daisy, whilst struggling to cope with a heartbreaking family revelation.

credits.title: Fierce Killer Marsupial
credits.overview: Two paranormal vloggers find themselves in a battle for survival against a 'drop bear', a terrifying killing machine from Australian folklore that disguises itself as a cute, cuddly koala.

credits.title: Flunk: Detention With Daisy
credits.overview: Headstrong Artemisia begins a voyage of self-discovery when she grows closer to musician Daisy in this new feature-length romance. Meanwhile, Kerri and Beth face their first relationship obstacle when Brayden sells them drugs.

credits.title: Ricky Stanicky
credits.overview: When three childhood best friends pull a prank gone wrong, they invent the imaginary Ricky Stanicky to get them out of trouble. credits.title: Reptile
credits.overview: A group of schoolboys engage in tomfoolery, but it’s not long before playful behaviour turns primal.

credits.title: The Echo
credits.overview: A coming of age tale. A young boy, on the outer of the outer, at the edge of the edge, in a nameless place, discovers the faster he goes, the closer he can get to outrunning his loneliness.
